spi_timing.recommendation: OLED writes at 8 MHz (no MISO). Expander and TMP122 reads at <= 5 MHz as a separate device configuration: at 8 MHz the MCP23S08 output (45 ns) plus the line leaves little of the 62.5 ns half-period before the ESP32 sampling edge.
